description: Read the PROVIDER'S DELIVERY RECORD. With nothing passed, counts only: how many records stand or ended and how much NET the open ones name, never a wallet. With guaranteeId, one record: its status and what that means, the NET it names, where the order it is for stands (read from the order's own record), and whether the wallet's balance still covers it, by a balance read at most 30 seconds earlier. With orderId, the records on one order, found by the order's id and never by a wallet. No wallet and no order id is ever shown. The program is held off until the operator switches it on: the counts say so plainly until then, and a record that exists can be read at any time; this tool moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through it. Free, keyless, nothing to sign. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

guaranteeId.description: One delivery record's id (the id it was made under).

orderId.description: Or the id of an order, to list the records on it. Never a wallet.

name: net_delivery_record_status
title: Read the delivery record counts, one record by its id, or the records on one order
